title: Implement viscoelastic model functions
action: Implement Python functions that compute the right‑hand side of the scalar ODE for B(t), the axial Cauchy stress T_ZZ, and the axial force f_z, using the published material parameters (μ₁=129.1267 MPa, μ₂=70.3011 MPa, ν=12.4878 MPa·s, β=0.5666) and given stretch history λ(t) and its time derivative.
description: Model implementation step required to compute downstream force curves.

title: Simulate stress‑relaxation experiments
action: For the three stress‑relaxation conditions (0.07 strain at 0.0325 s⁻¹, 0.07 strain at 0.0176 s⁻¹, and 0.08 strain at 0.0008 s⁻¹), reconstruct the stretch history λ(t) based on the reported stretch rates and hold periods, solve the ODE for B(t) with B(0)=1, and compute the axial force f_z(t). Write the combined force–time series to stress_relaxation_force.csv.
description: Force‑time curves for the three stress‑relaxation experiments with columns: test_id (string identifier of the condition), time_s (float, seconds), force_N (float, Newtons).

title: Simulate cyclic loading experiment
action: Construct the cyclic stretch history λ(t) for 20 cycles at 0.4 Hz, peak strain 0.06, strain ratio 0.1, solve the ODE for B(t) with B(0)=1, and compute the axial force f_z(t). Write the force–time series to cyclic_loading_force.csv.
description: Force‑time curve for the displacement‑controlled cyclic loading test (20 cycles, 0.4 Hz, peak strain 0.06, strain ratio 0.1). Columns: time_s (float, seconds), force_N (float, Newtons).
